en: The Couplets on the Association with the Taints and the Couplets on the Root-Conditions.

Dependent on a state that is associated with the taints (*āsava*) and is a root (*hetu*), there arises a state not associated with the taints and not a root, by way of root-condition (*hetupaccaya*) … three.
Dependent on a state dissociated from the taints and which is a root, there arises a state dissociated from the taints and not a root, by way of root-condition … three.
Dependent on a state both associated with the taints and a root, and dissociated from the taints and a root … [there arises a state] not associated with the taints … [three].
A non-root phenomenon arises conditioned by a root condition... three. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of the root condition;
three in the case of the object condition... pe ... one in the case of the result condition... pe ... nine in the case of the non-disappearance condition.
Dependent on a phenomenon associated with the taints and not a root, a phenomenon not associated with the taints and not a root arises conditioned by a root condition... three.

Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the taints (*āsava*) and is not a root (*na-hetu*), there arises a state that is not associated with the taints and is not a root, by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). … one. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are four … pe … under the resultant condition there is one … pe … under the non-disappearance condition there are four.
